content.thinking: Food prices rose 2.2% from September 2025 to September 2026, outpacing shelter's 1.8% by about 0.4 points, based on Statistics Canada's not-seasonally-adjusted CPI.

input.answer: Food costs rose faster. Using the not-seasonally-adjusted CPI for Canada, Sept 2025 to Sept 2026: Shelter 188.2 -> 191.5 = (191.5-188.2)/188.2 = +1.8%. Food 197.5 -> 201.8 = (201.8-197.5)/197.5 = +2.2%. Food rose about 0.4 percentage points more than shelter.

structured_output.answer: Food costs rose faster. Using the not-seasonally-adjusted CPI for Canada, Sept 2025 to Sept 2026: Shelter 188.2 -> 191.5 = (191.5-188.2)/188.2 = +1.8%. Food 197.5 -> 201.8 = (201.8-197.5)/197.5 = +2.2%. Food rose about 0.4 percentage points more than shelter.
